summaries.zh: DSH split-pane conversation plugin: PiUI-style multi-pane conversation surface — split/stack panes, per-pane sessions, sidebar session drag & drop, single-row fused header. Needs the renderer session-scope capability (see README).
summaries.en: DSH split-pane conversation plugin: PiUI-style multi-pane conversation surface — split/stack panes, per-pane sessions, sidebar session drag & drop, single-row fused header. Needs the renderer session-scope capability (see README).
